issue.title: Modernize the quote.md and podcasts.md vault notes
issue.description: ~/bob/quote.md and ~/bob/podcasts.md read like the vault's recent hand-authored notes instead of zorg conversion output: clean frontmatter, real Markdown structure, human-readable block IDs, and — for podcasts — one note per show behind a Bases dashboard, with every existing inbound and outbound link still resolving.

issue.title: Extract podcasts into per-show notes with a Bases dashboard
issue.description: podcasts: create the `[[podcast]]` type note, one `podcasts/<slug>.md` note for each of the 15 shows, a `podcasts.base` dashboard modeled on `eat.base`, and rewrite `podcasts.md` into a hub note that keeps all 17 legacy block anchors alive on its new lines.

issue.title: Rewrite quote.md as Obsidian quote callouts
issue.description: quote: convert all 32 zorg quote bullets in `quote.md` into `> [!quote]` callouts with human-readable block IDs, drop the dead zorg frontmatter and self-referential `[[quote]]` noise, and preserve every outbound wikilink and URL verbatim.

issue.title: Verify link integrity and vault render
issue.description: verify: re-check every inbound block reference, outbound wikilink, and URL touched by the two rewrites, confirm `podcasts.base` parses and renders, and confirm the vault working tree contains only the intended changes.

payload.entry: Rewrote ~/bob/quote.md as 32 > [!quote] callouts (backup at /tmp/bob_modernize_backup/quote.md). Verified: link-safety precondition still 0 inbound [[quote#^...]] refs before editing; 32 callouts / 32 block IDs, slugs match the plan table exactly and in file order; zero ^z- anchors, NNNNNN#XX prefixes, ID::/LID:: or ====== banners remain; frontmatter is exactly parent: "[[mind]]" with all zorg_* keys gone; all 3 URLs and all 12 distinct outbound wikilinks (incl. the 4x [[podcasts#^z-241027-07|twit]]) diff character-for-character against the backup, with only the 14 self-referential [[quote]] links dropped and [[lit_notes]] added per the plan's target shape; every wikilink target resolves to an existing note; %yeats/%feynman/%joshuai counts unchanged; git status shows only M quote.md from this phase, nothing committed. Judgment call: the plan's rules text says attribution goes on its own '> — Source' line, but all three of its worked examples put short attributions on the callout title line — I followed the examples for short attributions and used a separate '> — Source' line only for the three long block quotes (honesty-blunt-instrument, trump-lost-2020, satisficing).

PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP: Retarget the 36 inbound [[podcasts#^z-...]] links across ~20 vault notes to [[podcasts/<slug>]] — the legacy anchors still resolve, but per-show links would be more readable now that the notes exist.

PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP: eat.base is not embedded anywhere in the vault — eat.md was never modernized the way podcasts.md now is, so the restaurant dashboard is only reachable by opening the .base file directly.

Created ~/bob/podcast.md type note, 15 podcasts/<slug>.md per-show notes, podcasts.base (4 views modeled on eat.base), and rewrote podcasts.md as a hub note; added [[podcasts]] to mind.md Related notes. Verified: all 17 original ^z- anchors present exactly once in the new podcasts.md and nowhere else outside verbatim ## Source fences (anchor set diffs identical against the pre-rewrite backup); all 18 backup URLs each land in exactly one new file, character-for-character including the long Spotify ?si= query strings; podcasts.base parses under yaml.safe_load with views [Subscribed, All Podcasts, Unsubscribed, Recently Added]; 'bob query' returns exactly the 15 notes matching FROM "podcasts" WHERE type = [[podcast]] (9 subscribed / 6 unsubscribed); frontmatter of all 17 new/changed notes parses with quoted-wikilink parent/type; every wikilink target in the new files resolves to an existing .md/.base; no zorg frontmatter, ID::/LID::, NNNNNN#XX prefixes or ====== banners remain in podcasts.md. Vault working tree shows only M mind.md, M podcasts.md, ?? podcast.md, ?? podcasts.base, ?? podcasts/ on top of the pre-existing baseline; nothing staged or committed.

Verified all 3 phases against the live ~/bob vault, not just the phase notes.

quote.md: 32 '> [!quote]' callouts / 32 block IDs, slugs identical to the plan's 32-row table and in the same order; zero ^z- anchors defined in the file; no zorg_*/ID::/LID::/======/NNNNNN#XX scaffolding; frontmatter is exactly parent: "[[mind]]". Diffed against /tmp/bob_modernize_backup/quote.md: all 3 URLs identical, all outbound wikilinks identical including the 4x [[podcasts#^z-241027-07|twit]], with only the 14 self-referential [[quote]] links dropped and [[lit_notes]] added per plan. Inbound [[quote#^...]] refs vault-wide: still the documented 0 (the single grep hit is quote.md's own '![[quote#^<block-id>]]' usage example).

podcasts: podcast.md type note, podcasts.base, and all 15 podcasts/<slug>.md notes exist; frontmatter follows the eat/*.md schema (incl. source_lines). Unique ^z- anchor set in the new podcasts.md is identical to the backup's (17 unique; the backup's 19 occurrences included 2 duplicate anchor definitions that are correctly collapsed to one each). Ran the plan's inbound-anchor check across the vault: 0 MISSING ANCHOR for all 36 inbound [[podcasts#^...]] refs across 21 files. URL diff backup vs podcasts.md + podcasts/: zero lost URLs, Spotify ?si= strings intact. podcasts.base parses under yaml.safe_load with views [Subscribed, All Podcasts, Unsubscribed, Recently Added]; 'bob query -q' over FROM "podcasts" WHERE type = [[podcast]] returns exactly the 15 notes, 9 subscribed / 6 unsubscribed. Every wikilink target in quote.md, podcasts.md, podcast.md and podcasts/*.md resolves to an existing .md/.base (checked programmatically); frontmatter of all 18 files parses with quoted-wikilink parent/type. Accepted f.2's documented judgment call on attribution placement (followed the plan's worked examples over its prose rule).

Integration: no bob-cli repo commits landed since the epic started (latest is a53828a, 2026-08-05 15:00, epic created 2026-08-06 07:33), and grep across src/, docs/, scripts/, tests/ finds zero references to podcasts.md, quote.md, or the vault's type/base notes - nothing in this repo to update, no duplication or conflict. Vault-side, the only files touched since the epic began are the epic's own outputs plus mind.md (the one intended '- [[podcasts]]' line) and gtd_daily.md (unrelated daily task-status edits). Bryan has since committed the epic's work to the vault as 1d354ed 'feat: Modernize podcasts.md and quote.md'; the vault tree is otherwise clean. No 'just symvision' recipe exists in this repo and no epic-symbol whitelist entry mentions bob-cli-f, so there is nothing to expire.

Follow-ups: both PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP entries (from bob-cli-f.1) were re-verified and filed via /sase_new_task after confirming no semantic duplicate among existing task beads and no other in-progress epic - bob-cli-g (small, retarget the 36 inbound podcast anchor links to per-show notes; cosmetic, explicitly deferred by the plan) and bob-cli-h (medium, modernize eat.md into a hub note and surface eat.base, which is embedded in no vault note today). Both are ready for triage. Nothing was declined.
